en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a planned institutional complex, likely a hospital or barracks, composed of multiple large, symmetric masonry buildings with steep hipped roofs and dormer windows. The complex is arranged around internal courtyards and bordered by fences, with cultivated fields or gardens in the foreground and open countryside in the distance. A broad road runs along the right side, lined with similar buildings. The image has a distinctive trimmed, almost gabled upper border suggesting it was prepared as a postcard or printed view. No visible caption or text appears on the image itself.
